in_arabic.name: زريق
in_arabic.meaning: الزريق اسم يعني الشخص الذي يملك عينين زرقاوين أو شديد السواد
in_arabic.long_meaning: الزريق هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص الذي يملك عينين زرقاوين أو شديد السواد، وقد ورد في بعض المراجع أنه مشتق من كلمة الزريقاء التي تعني العين السوداء أو الزرقاء، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الأفنية والقصائد العربية القديمة

in_urdu.name: زریق
in_urdu.meaning: زریق کا مطلب ہے جس کی آنکھیں آسمان کی طرح نیلی ہوں یا بہت سیاہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: زریق ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے جس کی آنکھیں آسمان کی طرح نیلی ہوں یا بہت سیاہ، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں، جہاں یہ اسلامی ثقافت اور روایات کا حصہ ہے

in_hindi.name: ज़रीक
in_hindi.meaning: ज़रीक का अर्थ है जिसकी आँखें नीली हों या बहुत काली
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़रीक एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है जिसकी आँखें नीली हों या बहुत काली, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है, खासकर भारत में, जहां यह इस्लामी संस्कृति और परंपराओं का हिस्सा है

in_english.name: Zariq
in_english.meaning: Zariq means having blue or very black eyes
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zariq originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the word 'zarqā'' which means blue or black eyes. In Islamic tradition, names are chosen for their meanings and connotations. Zariq, therefore, signifies someone with striking eye color, often associated with beauty or spiritual depth. Historically, such names were used to describe notable companions of the Prophet Muhammad and other revered figures in Islamic history

data.cultural_impact: The name "Zariq" has historically been a popular one in the Islamic world, with many influential figures carrying this name. In various Arab and Muslim cultures, gold is considered a symbol of wealth, status, and prestige. Thus, the name Zariq, which means 'Golden,' has been associated with these cultural values and has been sought after by many parents for their children.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic faith, the name Zariq holds spiritual significance as well. The Prophet Muhammad(PBUH) is reported to have said, "Paradise hasneighborhoods, and it is called the 'Golden Neighborhood'. And its people are called the 'People of Residence' or the 'People of the Golden Road'." The name Zariq may be seen as a reminder of the spiritual journey towards Paradise, and the innate potential for all humans to attain it through righteous actions and faith in Allah. Additionally, the color gold is also associated with the largesse and generosity of Allah, as mentioned in the Quran, "And We have bestowed upon mankind, in it, all sorts of blessings." (2:28)
